name: Orbital Systems Gravlock Boot
description: A chunky, utilitarian boot in brushed gunmetal with visible magnetic coil housing built into the sole platform. The sole is thick and flat — nearly 4cm of integrated tech — with coil vents along the edges. Straps replace laces, securing the boot tightly for use in zero or low gravity. Originally designed for orbital construction crews; civilian and transport versions are now available.
functionality: Magnetic sole locks to ferrous surfaces with adjustable hold strength (0–200kg). Coil control via BCI or manual dial on the ankle strap. Works in vacuum with sealed liner.
what_it_says: You spend time off-planet, on a station, or aboard a ship. This is working gear for people who leave the ground.
story_hooks: The boots malfunction and lock to the hull mid-EVA — and someone is cutting the tether.
A pair surfaces groundside, scorch-marked, with traces of vacuum-rated sealant that's only used on one specific station.
